description: Nonary's Moonlight fork with VRR frame pacing and the PyroWave codec, for Vibepollo/Vibeshine hosts.
notes: Runs in portable mode: settings and pairings live in '$persist_dir', separate from stock Moonlight.
VRR pacing and PyroWave need a Vibepollo or Vibeshine host. Enable V-Sync and VRR in Moonlight's settings.
PyroWave needs a wired LAN with hundreds of Mbps; select it explicitly as the codec.
pre_install: # Moonlight only runs portable when portable.dat is in its *working directory*, not next to
# the exe. Shortcuts start in $dir, but the shim starts in the caller's directory and would
# fall back to the registry settings stock Moonlight uses. Launch through a wrapper that cds first.
if (!(Test-Path "$persist_dir$($cfg = '\Moonlight Game Streaming Project')")) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory "$dir$cfg" }
